cities.name: Sydney, Australia
cities.description: A vibrant harbor city known for the Sydney Opera House, coastal walks, and bright waterfront dining.

cities.name: Melbourne, Australia
cities.description: A creative city with laneway cafes, galleries, gardens, and a celebrated arts and food scene.

cities.name: Tokyo, Japan
cities.description: A high-energy capital where neon streets, serene shrines, design, and extraordinary food meet.

cities.name: Kyoto, Japan
cities.description: A graceful historic city famous for temples, gardens, tea houses, and seasonal cherry blossoms.

cities.name: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
cities.description: A lively coastal city with dramatic mountains, legendary beaches, music, and festival energy.

cities.name: Sao Paulo, Brazil
cities.description: Brazil's cultural and business hub, packed with museums, restaurants, nightlife, and street art.

temples.name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
temples.description: A vast temple complex with intricate stonework, lotus towers, and sunrise views over ancient ruins.

temples.name: Kiyomizu-dera, Japan
temples.description: A hillside Kyoto temple known for its wooden stage, city views, and surrounding historic lanes.

temples.name: Wat Arun, Thailand
temples.description: A riverside Bangkok landmark with porcelain mosaics, soaring spires, and beautiful evening light.

beaches.name: Bora Bora, French Polynesia
beaches.description: A lagoon paradise known for turquoise water, coral reefs, and peaceful overwater bungalows.

beaches.name: Copacabana Beach, Brazil
beaches.description: A famous Rio shoreline with mountain views, beach culture, kiosks, and a lively promenade.

beaches.name: Navagio Beach, Greece
beaches.description: A bright cove framed by cliffs and blue water, ideal for boat trips and unforgettable photos.
